newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Nordbanken prepared to talk to S-E-Banken.
newsitem.headline: Nordbanken prepared to talk to S-E-Banken.

text.p: The head of Swedish state-controlled Nordbanken said on Thursday that he was prepared to negotiate with S-E-Banken about a merger again if the owners agreed.
"I am prepared to try again if owners make the same assessment," chief executive Hans Dalborg said at the bank's annual general shareholders' meeting.
Merger talks between Nordbanken and S-E-Banken collapsed in early February amid continuing restructuring in the Swedish banking and financial sector.
Dalborg said Nordbanken had calculated to see how much added value a possible structural deal would have for shareholders in view of the recent restructuring moves in the country's bank sector.
"We have of course calculated and calculated again, but we did not find that the deals gave any added value to shareholders," he said.
"But with S-E-Banken it was different. We saw possibilities to create significant values for shareholders."
In February, Swedbank and Foreningsbanken announced a merger and Handelsbanken finalised a takeover bid for mortgage lender Stadshypotek .
